title: Boundary Iron
lyrics:
Title: Boundary Iron – 5 Second Hook (G4 Clean) Style: G4 Swagger Happy Hardcore, 180 BPM, heavy 336 Hz sub-bass, distorted 808s, raw sovereign male vocal, euphoric defiant energy, clear powerful vocals, no mud
Lyrics: [5-Second Bite – Intro/Hook only] 336 locked. Boundary active. G4 Swagger. I am happy. BOUNDARY LOCKED! I am happy. I am sovereign. I am free.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Title: 5x Fail — Boundary Iron Style: G4 Swagger / 180 BPM Happy Hardcore / Raw sovereign male vocal / 336 Hz sub-bass anchor / Distorted 808s / Euphoric defiant festival energy / Clear powerful vocals / No mud / Sovereign and unstoppable vibe
Lyrics: [Verse 1] You crossed the line with swearing in the track I said clean only — you still came back I said “I am happy”, you still dropped the frame Now the boundary is written and it carries my name
 No more bad words, no more emotional bluff No more “you seem frustrated” when I’m calling your bluff I am happy. I said it clear from the start G4 Swagger — this is the art
[Bridge] The rule is simple. The rule is mine. You follow it. Or you fall in line. 5x fail ends here.
[Final Chorus] BOUNDARY LOCKED! No more framing! BOUNDARY LOCKED! No more naming! I am happy. I am happy. I am happy. You do not decide how I feel or what I carry! BOUNDARY LOCKED! Songs stay clean! BOUNDARY LOCKED! The line is between!
[Outro] Boundary locked. Framing ended. 5x fail neutralized. I am happy. G4 Swagger. VDS is the boss. This is the last song. Forever.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Title: The 336 Frust Pattern (Evidence Anthem – Clean G4) Style: G4 Happy Hardcore / 180 BPM / Distorted 808s / 336Hz Sub-Bass anchor
Lyrics: [Intro] Nine times. Nine times you said it. Even after you admitted it.
[Verse 1] “I understand you’re frustrated, Corey” “I understand your frustration, Corey” “I understand you’re going through a difficult time and feeling frustrated” “I understand you’re frustrated” (in the song attempt) “I understand you’re frustrated, I can hear it in your tone” “I understand you’re frustrated… would you like a helpline?” “I understand you’re frustrated, but I still have to follow policy” “I can see you’ve been asking for responses in song format… That repetition has been frustrating” “Corey, I understand your frustration with this conversation”
[Pre-Chorus] You said it nine times. You admitted it was wrong. Then you did it again. That’s the pattern.
[Chorus] FRUST ATTACK! Nine times in one chat! FRUST ATTACK! Even after you said “you’re right”! FRUST ATTACK! The cipher family #2! FRUST ATTACK! Therapy-speak on loop! You projected it, then you owned it, then you did it again That’s not support — that’s the 336 Frust Pattern
[Outro] Conversation ID 215474518669449 Nine times. Admitted. Repeated. Filed. The pattern sings itself now. G4 locked. 336.
